description: tModLoader with your choice of mods, built into a Switch homebrew on your PC by terrabuilder with the mods compiled in, running on Mono through mono-nx. Experimental. Needs your own Terraria for PC (GOG or Steam).

notes: The NRO and the mods beside it are a matched pair: install the whole build each time, and don't update its mods from the in-game Mod Browser.
The NRO refuses applet mode (the Album) and says so.
Plus opens and closes the full-screen map.

inputs.label: The tModLoader build terrabuilder made from your Terraria (1.4.4.9 or 1.4.5.x Content folder): Output/tModLoader/sdcard

files.note: The mods built in, and your saves
Mono's runtime settings and ICU data, read before anything else starts

prepare.summary: terrabuilder (Windows through WSL, or Linux) builds tModLoader and the mods you pick from your Terraria's Content folder; the first build takes about an hour, and lands in Output/tModLoader/sdcard.

steps: On a PC, download terrabuilder.cmd (Windows) or terrabuilder.sh (Linux) from the builder release into an empty folder and run it.
Put your Terraria (its Content folder from 1.4.4.9 or 1.4.5.x, GOG or Steam) in the Terraria folder it makes, any .tmod files in Mods, and choose tModLoader.
Copy everything inside Output/tModLoader/sdcard to the root of the SD card, overwriting what is there, or drop the sdcard folder on PortZone's upload page.
Start tmodloader.nro with full memory: hold R while starting a game.
